text.p: Bonds gained in line with the trend elsewhere but the market lacked volume and traders said they saw the long end being content to maintain current spreads with Spain and Germany.
Trade was likely to remain subdued through to the end of the year with many banks already having closed their books.
"I think the spreads (for the 10 years) with Germany should hold between 100 and 115 basis points, with perhaps a slight tendency to move towards 100," said one trader.
"With Spain, they will remain flat or slightly negative," he added. --Fernanda Pargana, Lisbon bureau 3511-3150035
